title: Sizing is all wrong and sham does not have a large enough lip to cover the pillow correctly
text:
Sizing is all wrong and sham does not have a large enough lip to cover the pillow correctly. I am utterly disappointed in these pillowcases. First of all, I have a king-sized bed with king-sized pillows and some standard pillows. I ordered these in a king. However, the fit is a small standard and it is not even a good fit because the flap of the sham has too tiny a pocket to fit over the end of the pillow. Another negative is that these show and hold onto a lot of lint and cat hair.

Per my Internet search, these are the typical pillow sizes and the cases should be equivalent.

Standard Pillow Size 20" x 26"
Super Standard Pillow Size 20" x 28"
Queen Pillow Size 20" x 30"
King Pillow Size 20" x 36"

The box says these are King sized at 20" x 26" which is a full 10" shorter than needed. As can be seen in the photo, my king-sized pillow comes beyond the case. In the other photo, my standard pillow is even peeking out due to the cuff pocket being way too short.

The only thing good about these cases is the color and the feel. However, these are not functional due to the odd sizing and lack of correct pocket size for the end of the sham. The current price of $29.99 is outrageous for a substandard product. If it were perfect in sizing and sham pocket, then I would have rated this 5 stars and considered the price competitive.
